text.en:
1. Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Dadah Berbahaya nama.
(Pindaan Jadual Pertama) 1996.

2. Jadual Pertama kepada Akta Dadah Berbahaya 1952 adalah pasangan!
dipinda—                                           _

(a) dalam Bahagian II dengan menggantikan butiran "Resin
of Cannabis and substances of which such Resin forms
the base" dengan butiran "Cannabis resin and substances
of which such resin forms the base"; dan

(b) dalam Bahagian IJI—

(i) dengan memotong butiran "Cannabis (Indian Hemp)
‘and Cannabis resin (Resin of Indian Hemp)", "Coca
Leaf" dan "Opium, whether raw, prepared or
medicinal"; dan

(ii) dengan memasukkan selepas butiran "Etoxeridine"
butiran yang berikut:

"Extract or tincture of cannabis
Extract or tincture of coca leaves
Extract or tincture of opium".

Dibuat 3 April 1996.
[(24) JPN (Adv) 42; PN. (PU?) 214/IV.]

Dato' Chua Jur MENG,
Menteri Kesihatan

DANGEROUS DRUGS ACT 1952

Dangerous Drucs (AMENDMENT OF First SCHEDULE)
ORDER 1996

In exercise of the powers conferred by paragraph 45a(c) of the
Dangerous Drugs Act 1952, the Minister makes the following order: Act 234.
